home.homeDesc: Full-Stack Engineer building scalable, performance-driven web & mobile experiences with clean architecture and refined motion.

about.point1: I'm a Full-Stack Developer based in Jordan. I build scalable web and mobile applications with a strong focus on performance, structure, and clean architecture.
about.point2: I've engineered complex systems from scratch — custom UI layouts, interactive drag-and-drop experiences, and data-heavy interfaces designed to stay fast and predictable at scale.
about.point3: I care about how applications behave under real usage — how data flows, how components scale, and how interactions feel. My goal is to build products that are fast, predictable, and built to last.
about.point4: On the backend, I design structured APIs, model databases, and implement secure authentication and data flows with a focus on scalability and clarity. I work with Node.js and MongoDB to build reliable systems that handle real-time updates and data-heavy operations efficiently.

projects.notopia_desc: A modern note-taking app designed for organizing ideas, tasks, and reminders with a fast, seamless, and user-friendly experience.
projects.caterfy_desc: An all-in-one delivery and services app that makes everyday tasks more convenient, from ordering meals and groceries to accessing local services.
